script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Psychological
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

A SINGLE MOTHER, JESSICA, in her mid-30s, sits on her couch, scanning job listings on her laptop. Her eyes grow wide as she reads an ad for a position in a prestigious marketing firm. She looks up at her six-year-old son, ADAM, playing with his toys, a glint in her eyes.

JESSICA
(whispering)
I'm going to get this job, Adam. And when I do, we'll have a real home.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

Jessica prepares breakfast for Adam, her eyes darting between the stove and her phone. She lands an interview and excitedly shares the news with Adam.

ADAM
Mommy, are you going to wear your pretty dress?

JESSICA
(smiling)
Yes, sweetie. I think I'll wear my red dress.

INT. INTERVIEW ROOM - DAY

Jessica sits across from a stern PANEL OF INTERVIEWERs. She answers their questions calmly and eloquently, her ambition evident in every word.

INTERVIEWER #1
Why do you want to work for our firm?

JESSICA
I've always been drawn to the innovative marketing strategies you've employed. I want to contribute my creativity and energy to such a dynamic team.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica receives the call she's been waiting for, her heart racing. She's been offered the job. She shares the news with Adam, who claps excitedly.

ADAM
Mommy, can we get a big TV now?

JESSICA
(laughs)
Maybe, sweetie. But first, we need to buy some new clothes and school supplies.

INT. KITCHEN - MORNING

As Jessica prepares breakfast for Adam, she receives an email from her new employer. The deadline for their first major project is earlier than expected. She looks at Adam, worry etched on her face.

JESSICA
(to herself)
I'll work late tonight. I'll make this work.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

Jessica sits at her new desk, surrounded by stacks of papers and marketing materials. She works tirelessly, fueled by her ambition and the desire to provide for her family.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - DAY

Jessica walks through the door, exhausted but triumphant. Adam greets her with a hug, oblivious to the stress that's been etched on her face.

ADAM
Mommy, you look tired. Did you have a good day?

JESSICA
(smiling)
Yes, sweetie. I had a very good day.

INT. OFFICE - NIGHT

Jessica is late for another deadline, her work piling up around her. She collapses onto her desk, overwhelmed. Suddenly, her phone rings. It's a call from her mother, concerned about her well-being.

JESSICA
(voicemail)
Hi, Mom. I'm working late, but everything's under control. I'll call you soon.

INT. APARTMENT LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

Jessica returns home, still exhausted but determined. She tucks Adam into bed and sits on the couch, her laptop open in front of her. She scrolls through job listings, her ambition renewed.

JESSICA
(to herself)
I can do this. I will do this.

FADE OUT.

THE END
